description: Intensidades medias de tráfico y velocidades. Red Regional de Carreteras is a dataset listed in analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es. Intensidades medias diarias de tráfico, composición y velocidades de la Red Regional de Castilla y León. Frecuencia de actualización: Anual. Coverage: Castilla y León. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are intensidad de circulación, tráfico, imd, intensidad media diaria, red de carreteras. The portal shows 15,591 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2017-11-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-analisis-datosabiertos-jcyl-es-portal.
